content_units: Kyoto Dinner Fit for 19:00 Near Gion-Shijo

For your group of four,   Yasai Bistro   is the best match overall, with   Obanzai Corner   as the backup. Both stay within budget and within the 20-minute walking limit, but Yasai Bistro aligns better with the vegetarian need and quieter setting.
Best Pick and Backup
Option   Walk from Gion-Shijo   Dietary Fit   Atmosphere   Est. Total for 4   Verdict
Yasai Bistro   12 min   Strong for vegetarian; likely manageable for shellfish avoidance   Quiet   ¥12,800     Best overall
Kamo Grill   8 min   Weak for vegetarian; seafood-heavy raises shellfish risk   Lively   ¥18,000   Not ideal
Kyoto Noodles House   18 min   Acceptable for vegetarian   Casual/noisy   ¥7,200   Too noisy for preference
Obanzai Corner   15 min   Good for shellfish-free choices; vegetarian less certain   Moderate noise   ¥15,200     Best backup
Option 1: Yasai Bistro   Best overall match for dietary needs and atmosphere     ¥12,800 total
- Best fit for the   vegetarian diner  , since the restaurant is explicitly vegetarian-friendly.
- The   quiet atmosphere   directly matches your preference better than any other candidate.
- At   12 minutes on foot  , it is comfortably inside your walking limit.
- Estimated food total is   ¥12,800 before drinks  , leaving a good buffer under your   ¥18,000   cap.
- Also reduces risk for the guest avoiding shellfish, since it is not centered on seafood.
Option 2: Obanzai Corner   Safest backup if you want a broader Kyoto-style menu     ¥15,200 total
- Still within budget and walking range at   15 minutes  .
- Clearly offers   shellfish-free choices  , which is helpful for one guest.
- Noise level is   moderate  , so it is less ideal than Yasai Bistro but still more suitable than the lively/noisy alternatives.
- Backup rather than first choice because vegetarian suitability is   less clearly supported   than at Yasai Bistro.
Why the Other Two Fall Short
-   Kamo Grill
- Seafood-heavy menu is the biggest mismatch for your group.
- Vegetarian fit looks poor.
- Atmosphere is lively rather than quiet.
- It only just fits the budget at   ¥18,000 total  , with no margin.
-   Kyoto Noodles House
- Budget-friendly and technically workable for the vegetarian diner.
- But the   casual/noisy   setting conflicts with your quieter dinner preference.
- It is also the longest walk at   18 minutes  .

Decision Notes
Context used: I ranked the candidates by your stated priorities in order — dietary fit, budget, walking distance, then quieter atmosphere.
-   Recommended:     Yasai Bistro
-   Backup:     Obanzai Corner
